#!/usr/bin/env python3 """ Utility to safely format a blog post for web display. """ from html import escape import re # A minimal but realistic HTML template. The placeholders `{title}` and `{body}` # are replaced with the sanitized heading and description. BLOG_FORMAT = """

{title}

{body}
""" # Regular expression to strip any existing HTML tags that might have been # inadvertently included by the user. This is an extra safety layer. TAG_RE = re.compile(r'<[^>]+>') def _sanitize(text: str) -> str: """ Escapes special HTML characters and removes any stray tags. """ # First escape &, <, >, ", ' escaped = escape(text, quote=True) # Then remove any tags that might have slipped through cleaned = TAG_RE.sub('', escaped) return cleaned def display_blog(heading: str, description: str) -> str: """ Prepare a user‑submitted blog post for safe HTML rendering. Parameters ---------- heading : str The main title of the blog post. description : str The full body text of the blog post. Returns ------- str A complete HTML snippet ready to be embedded in a page. Raises ------ ValueError If either argument is not a string. """ if not isinstance(heading, str): raise ValueError("heading must be a string") if not isinstance(description, str): raise ValueError("description must be a string") safe_title = _sanitize(heading) safe_body = _sanitize(description) # Use str.format with explicit placeholders to avoid accidental injection. return BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_title, body=safe_body)
